spec: Create exactly one new file named A_LIST.txt at the project root. It must contain the integers 1 through 150, one integer per line (1 on the first line, 150 on the last line), and nothing else. Do not modify any other file.

stories.description: Add a single new file named A_LIST.txt at the project root containing the integers 1 through 150 in order, one integer per line (1 on the first line, 150 on the last line), with nothing else in the file. No other file may be created or modified.

tasks.spec: Work at the project root (this directory already contains only README.md, .gitignore, .mcp.json, and a .datawatch/ helpers directory — do not modify any of them). Create exactly one new file named A_LIST.txt in the project root. It must contain the integers 1 through 150 in ascending order, one integer per line: line 1 is '1', line 150 is '150', with a trailing newline after 150 and no other characters, whitespace, blank lines, or content. Use shell seq, or a shell loop (e.g. a for loop with i from 1 to 150 printing i, or awk 'BEGIN{for(i=1;i<=150;i++)print i}') to generate the content, then verify with head/tail and a line count. Finally run the verification script .datawatch/verify/create-a-list-txt.sh (it must print 'OK: A_LIST.txt contains exactly 1..150, one per line') and ensure it passes. Do not touch, create, or delete any file other than A_LIST.txt.
